Fee cost — 0.5% annual fee

This calculator compares the ending value with no fee versus a 0.5% annual investment fee. Model: net return = gross return − fee.

Short answer A 0.5% annual fee reduces the ending value relative to no fee. The exact dollar impact depends on balance, return, and time horizon.
